sessions.title: Back Movement + Sauna
sessions.goal: Protect the knee after Saturday's pinch signal. Keep the back moving. Use heat. Do not add loading today.
sessions.success: Knee stays quiet. Back feels better after movement + sauna. Fresh for Wednesday.
sessions.note: No lunges. No weighted strength. Charl's call after the under-kneecap/shin pinch on bodyweight single-leg work. Correct decision.

blocks.title: Easy Movement
blocks.note: All easy. Nothing sharp. If anything bothers the knee, stop and go straight to sauna.

blocks.title: MoveU Cool-down — Lordosis L2 (hold 2–3 weeks)
blocks.note: Same block until consistency is solid, then progress in MoveU app. No added weight. Log reps/time quality. Alignment layer after main session.

exercises.name: Deep Tissue: All Hip
exercises.focus: Slow pressure. Breathe. Don't force into pain.
exercises.note: Soft tissue prep for the hip block.

exercises.name: Side Lying Hip Lift Rotations
exercises.focus: Controlled rotation. Pelvis stacked. No lumbar flop.

exercises.name: Kickback Rotations
exercises.focus: Glute drives the kickback. Ribs quiet. Smooth rotation.

exercises.name: Double Leg Hip Rotations
exercises.focus: Low back stays calm. Move from hips, not spine.

exercises.name: TFL / Glute Med Stretch
exercises.focus: Easy breath. Soften into the stretch, don't yank.

questions: Any residual knee sensation today, even mild?
How does the back feel after movement + sauna?

sessions.title: Build the Foundation
sessions.goal: Return to Wed–Sun rhythm. Hinge strength, upper balance, controlled work. Protect the knee; keep back calm under load.
sessions.success: Leave better than you arrived. Knee quiet. Trap bar crisp. Consistent effort — not a hero day.
sessions.note: Refined after Mon 10 Aug recovery submit. Sleep/energy 4/5, back readiness 5, finished a bit tight (3) from new MoveU work (good pain). Knee questions blank — treat as clear but still no BSS. Default C1 = goblet squat. Reverse lunge only if knee fully quiet through warm-up. Bike intervals stay short (15/45).

items.name: Bodyweight Squats
items.focus: Check knee — must be quiet before loading.

items.name: Trap Bar build-up
items.focus: Brace. Push floor away. Glutes finish. Control lower.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.focus: Every rep identical. Stop a set early if brace softens.

blocks.title: Strength — C
blocks.note: No BSS. Knee still on watch after Sat pinch. Goblet squat is the default.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.focus: Controlled. Knees track toes. Stop if any under-kneecap pinch.
exercises.note: Swap to reverse lunge only if knee fully quiet through warm-up AND goblet feels trivial. Otherwise stay goblet.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.focus: Walk tall. Soft ribs. Even steps.

items.name: Bike
items.focus: Consistent output. Build capacity gradually. No hero intervals.
